properties.note: Hand-drawn from Giovani's circled map. NYC (minus Staten Island via areas.json), southern Westchester Sound shore (Yonkers to Port Chester, White Plains excluded), all of Long Island (Nassau + Suffolk, the full PSEG Long Island territory) out to Montauk and Orient Point. Fishers Island is left out (its own utility, not PSEG LI). Redraw at geojson.io to move the edge.
